# 4.79 Seventy-ninth assembly district.
All of the following territory in Dane County constitutes the 79th assembly district:
(1) That part of the town of Madison comprising U.S. census tract 407, blocks 3004, 3022, and 3023.
(2) That part of the town of Middleton comprising U.S. census tract 204, block 3012; and tract 407, block 3008; and tract 408, blocks 2002, 2008, 2013, and 2014.
